title: archive: recover ps-vue-src — lost Headstock Suite modules
intent: Preserve, beside the four views #438 archived, the 2026-03-17 standalone ps-vue app output the owner recovered from claude.ai on 2026-10-15. It is the source record for two of the five lost modules (types, store), reconstruction input for two (headstockData, useParametric); useHeadstock is still lost. Archive only.
behavior_change: None. No file under packages/client/src, the router, the four archived views, ceilings or baselines changes. The recovered files sit outside vue-tsc's src/** include and outside the client lint tree.

diff_articulation.what_changed: 15 files added under archive/experimental/2026-03/headstock-suite-refined/ps-vue-src/ (14 recovered sources as delivered + a recovery README), the parent README's import map, and one integrity test.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: None of the 13 other files exists in any Git ref; useDxfImport.ts and ImportView.vue match the copies already archived from the 2026-03-17T091407 bundle, which dates them.
